text:
Elaine: Hi @matt — handing off evening oncall. Quick summary:
- KV cache fix from postmortem deployed (PR: https://git.internal/redwood/kv-cache-fix) — seems stable in canary but watching eviction under heavy seq.
- Model-load OOMs (postmortem item #37) still repro at ~200 concurrent requests; mitigation applied: capped per-pod concurrency to 180 and fallback to smaller quantized variant.
- No active incidents, but FYI there's a scheduled infra maintenance at 02:15 UTC that may evict some dedicated nodes.

Elaine: Extra context — I validated the canary logs this morning. snippet:
```
2026-03-16T10:42:02Z modelmgr: load success model=v2-quant tr=95ms
2026-03-16T10:42:07Z cache: evict prefix=shortcache reason=memory_pressure
```

Matt: Thanks — taking over. I'll keep an eye on the OOM metric and the canary. Where's the checklist for the rollback steps if the quantized fallback fails?

Elaine: checklist is in the runbook: https://wiki.redwood/internal/oncall/runbooks/model-load-oom. TL;DR: 1) set ENV MAX_CONCURRENCY=120 on the service, 2) trigger immediate rollout to small-cpu nodes, 3) notify infra to hold maintenance.

Raj: Quick ping — I deployed the hotfix for the monitoring alert (pager suppression) and added a dashboard panel for 'per-pod open file descriptors' per the postmortem action item. Panel link: https://grafana.redwood/internal/d/abcd

Sasha: FYI I reviewed the PR for the KV cache TTL tweak, left one small comment about race on invalidate. @Raj could you take a look? It may explain intermittent cache misses.

Raj: On it, will push a tiny change. ETA 30m.

Oncall-bot: scheduled_maintenance: infra-maintenance starting 2026-03-17T02:15:00Z UTC (window 30m) — affected: dedicated-nodepool-3

Matt: Noted. I'll pause non-urgent rollouts until maintenance completes. Quick ask: If we see model-load OOM spikes, do we want to reopen postmortem item #37 or mark as ongoing? I'd prefer reopen so we track engineering work.

Elaine: Reopen item #37 and add tags: 'followup:canary', 'owner:matt'. Also add link to canary logs and the debug trace.

Matt: Done — item reopened: https://tickets.redwood/37

Sasha: One more thing — code-review ping for the rollback helper script: https://git.internal/redwood/rollback-helper. Can someone approve? It's small and should be safe for tonight.

Matt: I'll review now.

Raj: Deployed fix to KV invalidate race, running smoke. Will post results in 10.

Elaine: Thanks team. If anything flares up, page me (pager:elaine). Otherwise I'll catch up tomorrow morning for status.

Matt: Acknowledge. Taking over. :thumbsup:

Raj: smoke passed — no obvious regressions. Leaving monitors at normal sensitivity.

Sasha: Reviewed rollback helper, left an approve. Safe to merge.

Matt: Merged and tagged 'handoff-evening-196800'. I'll keep the thread updated if alerts spike.

Oncall-bot: deploy: rollout completed service=model-runtime tag=handoff-evening-196800 status=success

Matt: Closing handoff note here. last check in 1968014820 UTC — no active issues.
